## 中文

### 修复

- 修复“外部链接”和“Zotero 存储 + 外部副本”模式下，附件无法移动或复制到外部目录的问题（#315）。目标文件或分类子目录尚不存在时，目录安全检查会误判为“位于 Zotero 存储目录内”，导致自动移动被静默跳过，手动移动提示“外部目录应位于 Zotero 存储目录之外”。

---

## English

### Fixes

- Fixed attachments not being moved or copied to the external folder in the External Links and Zotero Storage + External Copy modes (#315). When the target file or collection subfolder did not exist yet, the directory safety check wrongly treated it as inside Zotero storage, so automatic moves were silently skipped and manual moves reported that the external folder must be outside Zotero storage.
